A product-focused Data Scientist with 5 years of experience deploying AI systems into production across labour markets, legal services, and environmental compliance. I am drawn to Mistral because I believe frontier AI is most powerful when it is rigorously measured, continuously improved, and genuinely useful — and I want to work with the team building it. I have used Mistral models in production, designed feature experiments for deployed AI chatbots, and built end-to-end data pipelines that turn complex unstructured data into actionable insight. I thrive at the intersection of product, research, and engineering: equally comfortable writing a SQL query to diagnose an edge case as presenting findings to a non-technical client. I am relocating to Paris and excited to contribute to Mistral's mission of building open, sovereign, and transformative AI.
